definition: Dan Hendrycks (born 1994 or 1995) is an American machine learning researcher.
details: He serves as the director of the Center for AI Safety, a nonprofit research organization based in San Francisco, California.
story: Think of a lightbulb moment: the idea was always there, but someone had to point a finger at it. Behind the jargon is an idea you could explain to a friend over coffee. At its heart it is a simple notion, once you strip away the fancy name. Once you see it, you cannot unsee it. And that idea, made concrete, is Dan Hendrycks.
